text:
maria: Pen test report just landed — I put the full findings + attachments in the drive folder (link above). High/critical items need owners and a short remediation plan by EOD tomorrow. We also need to lock down any RBAC/KMS surface that would affect the retest window.

jason: Reviewing now. Can we get a quick mapping of which findings touch KMS keys or service roles? I can run a grep across terraform and IAM manifests.

sam: I started a spreadsheet with columns: finding id, severity, affected service, suggested owner, blocker (yes/no), estimates. Shared at https://tiny.redwood/pt-triage. Pls add as you triage.

maria: Perfect. Priority guidance: critical -> remediate before retest (no partial fixes), high -> target for canary patch then retest, medium/low -> schedule in next sprint but still document mitigations.

alex: For KMS: two findings mention unconstrained key usage in analytics pipeline (finding 12 & 13). Short-term mitigation: rotate keys for analytics-only key and restrict via key policy to analytics role. Longer-term: move to envelope encryption with per-tenant data keys.

jason: I captured the terraform refs: `modules/kms/*` and `infra/iam/roles-analytics.tf` — will open PRs to pin the key policy, add `kms:ViaService` constraints and remove wildcard principals.

sam: RBAC change plan: propose an ephemeral grant flow for the assessor role (timeboxed STS assume role with MFA). Draft snippet below:

```
resource "aws_iam_role" "assessor_temp" {
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.assessor_temp.json
  max_session_duration = 3600
}
```

That will make it easier to hand auditors scoped access for the retest window.

maria: Good — include an audit log toggle so we can capture elevated sessions. We need clear audit exports for evidence. On logs: export CloudTrail + KMS CloudWatch logs for the retest period to the evidence bucket and snapshot to the readroom.

security-bot: @channel Reminder: create a signed evidence bundle for each fix. Use `scripts/evidence/gather.sh --start 2024-03-01 --end 2024-03-07` to collect traces and key events.

jason: small ops question — if we rotate analytics keys, will it break any batch jobs? Who owns the DAGs? @data-team? We should schedule rotation during a low-traffic window and have rollback.

maria: Data team owns those DAGs. I've pinged them (cc @data on the spreadsheet). For any breaking change, include a canary flag and circuit breaker.

alex: Regarding retest schedule: propose two 4-hour retest slots next week (Mon 10–14 UTC, Thu 18–22 UTC). Assessors requested read-only evidence bundle 24h before. We should freeze config changes 2h before each slot.

sam: I'll add Jira labels: `pt:critical`, `pt:high`, `pt:needs-evidence`. Assign owners and due dates. Also linking to the spreadsheet rows.

jason: For audit logging exports, command to generate the CloudTrail export:
```
aws cloudtrail create-export-task --cli-input-json '{"trailName":"prod-trail","startTime":"2024-03-01T00:00:00Z","endTime":"2024-03-07T00:00:00Z","s3Bucket":"redwood-pt-evidence"}'
```
We should run that after fixes and include SHA256 of bundle.

maria: Ops checklist for remediation sprint (short):
• owner assigned in Jira
• PR open with rollback plan & test coverage
• KMS/key policies updated (if applicable)
• ephemeral assessor roles created + audit enabled
• evidence export scheduled + SHA documented
• retest slot scheduled

oncall: Noted — I'll block the retest slots on the calendar and make an alert channel for the retest day. Also will act as staging bridge during the window.

alex: A couple of technical asks for the PRs: add a policy statement that denies `kms:Decrypt` unless `aws:SourceIp` is from internal VPC CIDRs and `aws:RequestTag/owner` present. Pseudocode:
```
Effect: Deny
Action: kms:Decrypt
Condition: Not (IpAddress arn:aws:ec2:...)
```
That gives immediate mitigation.

jason: Will include test harness run: `make ci-acceptance` against staging after changes. If it fails, automatic rollback with terraform state revert.

maria: Let's aim to have owners & PRs for all critical/high findings by EOD tomorrow. I'll run a sitrep call 09:30 PT to lock priorities. If anyone can't make it, drop updates in the thread.

sam: Adding a post-retest retrospective template in the spreadsheet so we capture lessons (what broke, what was flaky, time to remediate).

security-bot: Meeting created: "PT remediation sitrep" — 2024-03-05T16:30Z. Attendees: maria, jason, sam, alex, oncall. Link: https://meet.redwood/pt-sitrep

maria: Thanks — if you take an owner, comment in the spreadsheet row and tag `@maria` so I can verify. We'll also need a small readroom to hand over evidence (presigned URLs) after export is complete.

alex: One last note: for any fix that touches customer-facing keys, run it through legal/regulatory review. I'll flag those rows in the sheet.

maria: Great work team. We'll reconvene in the sitrep. If blockers pop up (ops, infra, data), call me on pager. :white_check_mark:
